AN OPEN-SOURCE PROJECT
About InoQuill
InoQuill is a free, open-source converter for Arduino keyboard sketches. It turns supported code into DuckyScript and shows how the output relates to your original sketch. Everything runs in your browser.
Clear boundaries
InoQuill handles the keyboard operations listed in the compatibility guide. Some Arduino features have no direct DuckyScript equivalent, so you may need to adapt your sketch.
Supported code
Text, key presses, delays, and supported loops and helper functions. Check compatibility.
Unsupported operations
When an operation cannot be translated, an error points to the line that needs attention. Board-specific actions such as GPIO are left out and listed in the review notices.
Before you use the output
Review the script, choose the correct keyboard layout, and test on a system you own or are authorized to assess.
Compatibility and limitations
References, with credit
InoQuill grew out of an appreciation for Spacehuhn’s Duckify, Duckuino, SAPSAN Terminal, and Hak5’s documentation. Their work inspired this project and helped make it possible. Thank you to the creators and contributors who make these tools and resources available to everyone.
